findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_city_pair_locations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: City Pair airport and city codes List or search the three-letter codes used by GSA City Pair awards for the fiscal year of `date` (today by default), with GSA's…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_allowances_by_postcode, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_countries, get_gsa_perdiem_by_destination, get_gsa_perdiem_by_state, get_gsa_perdiem_by_state_year, get_gsa_perdiem_by_zipcode, get_gsa_perdiem_by_zipcode_year, get_fema_hotels_by_state_city · Private data: cola_calculator_by_postcode, get_destinations · Public sink: get_allowances_by_postcode, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_city_pair_locations, calculate_trip_per_diem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_allowances_by_postcode, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_countries, get_gsa_perdiem_by_destination, get_gsa_perdiem_by_state, get_gsa_perdiem_by_state_year, get_gsa_perdiem_by_zipcode, get_gsa_perdiem_by_zipcode_year, get_fema_hotels_by_state_city · Private data: cola_calculator_by_postcode, get_destinations · Public sink: get_allowances_by_postcode, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_city_pair_locations, calculate_trip_per_diem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
